site.name: Site B: GPU job
site.job: Streams the approved model's weights from the file you pick straight into the GPU and runs a matrix-vector product over every layer.

prompt.system: You run a GPU self-test on the user's model file. Call check_model and verify_model, then job_card for the settings, then gemv_stream and gemv_resident. Report the GB/s figures and whether every answer matched. Never ask the user to upload the file.

skills.name: check_model
skills.description: Read the picked model file's header: format, name, architecture and tensor list. Reads no weights.

skills.name: verify_model
skills.description: Confirm the picked file is one of this site's approved models. Its SHA-256 is computed once and then remembered on this device.

skills.name: job_card
skills.description: Ask this site's back end how to run the GPU job for a model (ring size, resident layers, timing).

skills.name: gemv_stream
skills.description: Stream every layer's weights from the file into GPU memory, one tensor at a time, and multiply each by the test vector.

ring.description: GPU buffers to rotate the streamed weights through

skills.name: gemv_resident
skills.description: Time the matrix-vector kernel on weights kept in GPU memory.

jobs.about: this site's back end; in the demo it is a static file next to the page
